title: Bungalows or mobile homes
content: Lately I keep ending up in a woodsy area with a lot of bungalows/mobile homes grouped together and the vibe is very eerie. It’s quiet and I don’t see other people around but i can feel the presence of someone/ghosts idk inside these bungalows so I’m always trying to be quiet and sneaking around. I always try to leave there before it gets dark. Does this sound familiar to anyone? It’s located near a very suburban and very urban neighborhood and also close to the multilevel parking structure.
